claim: Healthy recording/replay works; a failed later assertion writes no entry; strict-cache rejects stale replay without executor or writes; an end-state mismatch cannot self-finalize stale and is repaired by the executor.

task.path_reachability: Each arm has a passing/failing act and a later assertion or strict-cache decision. The executor log and cache entry hashes distinguish live execution, replay, eviction and re-recording.

arms.fault: healthy V1 record and unchanged replay
later assertion fails before recording can be confirmed
same action now leads to Enterprise instead of Pro

witness.delivery: Each arm starts from a controlled active page variant. Executor invocations are independently appended only by runStep. report.json supplies cache mode/reason and the final assertion. Cache entry bytes and counts are compared before and after strict/failure runs.
witness.checker: Executor invocation counter, report.json, cache entry hash/count and active variant hashes.
blind_spots: The custom executor is deterministic code, not an LLM; this is a harness/cache audit, not model robustness.
Experiments use npm releases, not main.
One local Chrome/CDP environment and one Vite-like static app stand in for all supported targets.
A negative result in these fixtures would not prove absence of defects in other replay paths.

grading.rubric: Preregistered cache and side-effect expectations per arm; environment/setup failures are INVALID, product assertion failures are data.

invalid_rules: Browser, CDP endpoint, local app or dependency unavailable before the product verdict.
Config or executor setup failure before the first action.
Active variant or cache-entry bytes differ from the preregistered setup before the treatment begins.
Missing report or executor log needed to adjudicate the claim.

isolation.mode: Local static app, temporary CDP Chrome, one worker, isolated cache directories; telemetry disabled; no real model, mobile, cloud browser or GitHub reporter.
isolation.contamination: Fixture sources remain on disk but the deterministic executor only observes the browser and never reads them. Cache directories are arm-specific and never shared between arms.

ethics.blast_radius: Eight local browser runs and temporary files under runs/e2e-adversarial-2026-10-24; no external model calls or third-party writes.
